entities.title: Chess Worker
entities.summary: The Cloudflare Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/chess: the page behind the sign-in, the JSON API, a Durable Object per online game, and the static game.
entities.purpose: index.ts routes; auth.ts maps icelander.net's sign-in to Gambit's own users; api.ts answers the lobby, invitations, contacts, games, history and profile pictures; room.ts runs each online game's actions one at a time through actions.ts and broadcasts the result; db.ts and schema.sql are the D1 database; mail.ts emails invitations through Resend.
boundaries: Sign-in itself is icelander.net's login service, reached through vendor/icelander-auth (never edited here) and the ACCOUNTS service binding.
The rules and the API's types are shared/; the Godot client is the only caller in production.
